msg: Ok I just finished the game at hand and did very good. Points was way up in the 4 digits. So I read the advice that was left for me and I did takes parts of the advice only because they had played the game and found what they think helped them. So you will have a few breaks take them stand up move round on the cool look out side it will help your eyes focus better. This game is like flipping a coin. You can flip a coin heads or tails 4 times in a row and just about every time it will come out as if the first flip is heads the 2nd and 3rd will be tails. 4th flip will be heads. So if its heads it goes h/t/t/h of if tails t/h/h/t. so thats how i played the game. I always started game h/t/t/h or left right right left. Do not worry bout the colors or the size of the guys. If you do not think this sysrem is a very good system then just flip a coin real quick 4 times and see what you get. If you do not take this advice you may find something that works for you. But take the breaks rest your eyes looking out side is best. Get up and move round for a minute or 2. Do not worry about missing some cause I missed a few myself but put the system back to work and came out very very good at the end with a hand full of misses not fast enough and a few 0s. Good luck.
